title: Associate Director, Enterprise Systems Finance Business Operations
description:
**Job Purpose:**

Associate Director-Enterprise Systems Finance Business Operations is responsible for driving the financial management, operational performance and business rhythm to the Enterprise Systems function. The Associate Director translates complex financial data and operational metrics into actionable insights that support investment decisions, resource planning and continuous improvement across the Enterprise Systems portfolio. They work closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure headcount, vendor spend and programme budgets are managed effectively, and that the Enterprise Systems function is equipped to meet its commitments within agreed financial guardrails.

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own and manage the Enterprise Systems financial planning cycle, ensuring budgets are accurately maintained, variances are understood and explained and financial commitments are met.
* Serve as the primary finance and operational business partner to Enterprise Systems leadership, providing proactive financial analysis, cost modelling, and investment appraisal to support prioritisation and decision-making.
* Maintain a consolidated view of Enterprise Systems spend across run, change, and invest categories — including internal headcount costs, external vendor and managed service contracts, software licences, and capital expenditure — ensuring accurate allocation and recharging where required.
* Lead the operational management of Enterprise Systems vendor and contract portfolio, including purchase order creation, invoice approval, accruals management, and contract renewal tracking in partnership with Procurement and Legal teams.
* Develop and maintain the Enterprise Systems management information pack, providing regular reporting on financial performance, headcount, productivity, and operational KPIs to senior leadership and relevant governance bodies.
* Support the Enterprise Systems leadership team in preparing business cases for investment, ensuring financial modelling, benefit quantification, and risk assessment are robust and aligned to GSK's investment approval standards.
* Partner with HR Business Partners to manage headcount planning, contractor and contingent worker governance, role change processes, and workforce cost tracking across the Enterprise Systems function.
* Drive continuous improvement in financial processes, reporting tools, and operational workflows within the Enterprise Systems function, identifying AI/automation and simplification opportunities that reduce administrative burden and improve data quality.
* Support the Director Enterprise Systems Business Operations in preparing materials for senior leadership meetings, business reviews, and governance forums, ensuring financial and operational content is accurate, well-structured, and presented at the right level of detail.
* Ensure compliance with GSK financial controls, procurement policies, and internal audit requirements across all Enterprise Systems financial and operational activities.
* Act as a subject matter expert on Enterprise Systems financial processes, tooling, and data, providing guidance to the broader team and supporting onboarding of new team members to financial ways of working.
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
  

  

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

  

* 15 to 19years of professional experience with bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Commerce, Economics, Information Systems or related field.
* 10+ years of experience in finance operations, finance systems, reporting or controls in a large organisation.
* Practical experience using ERP or enterprise finance systems (e.g., SAP, Ariba, Oracle, Workday) to support budgeting, reporting, procurement, financial controls, and month-end processes.
* Experience working in a finance business partnering, financial management, or IT financial operations role within a large, complex organisation.
* Proven experience managing technology or IT function budgets, including headcount cost management, vendor spend, and capital/operational expenditure tracking.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to produce high-quality financial analysis, forecasts, and management information that supports executive decision-making.
* Experience working as a trusted business partner to senior technology or functional leaders, translating financial complexity into clear, actionable guidance.
* Familiarity with procurement, vendor management, and contract governance processes, including purchase order management and invoice approval workflows.
* Exposure to workforce planning processes, including headcount tracking, contractor governance, and role change management.
* Experience supporting business case development, including financial modelling, benefit quantification, and investment appraisal.
* Experience working within structured financial governance, internal controls, and audit frameworks.
Demonstrated ability to understand and experiment with AI and automation to improve data quality and reporting output  

**Preferred Skills:**  
  
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus.

  
  

* Professional finance qualification such as CA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA, or equivalent.
* Experience with business intelligence tools and data modelling (for example Power BI, Tableau, Qlik).
* Prior experience in program or project delivery across finance and technology.
* Exposure to control frameworks, compliance or risk management in a global environment.
* Experience working in an internal company matrix environment and with external vendors or service providers.
* Familiarity with automation, RPA or system integration concepts.
* Strong communication and influencing skills, able to present complex financial information clearly and confidently to non-finance stakeholders at all levels of seniority.
* Strong financial modelling and data analysis skills, able to build robust forecasts, cost models, and business cases that withstand senior scrutiny.
* Highly organised and detail-oriented, able to manage multiple financial cycles, reporting deadlines, and operational workstreams simultaneously without loss of accuracy.
* Proactive and commercially minded, able to identify financial risks and opportunities and bring them to the attention of senior leaders with recommended courses of action.
* Comfortable working within structured governance, compliance, and internal control frameworks, ensuring all financial activities meet GSK's policies and audit standards.
Strong analytical mindset, able to weigh value, risk, complexity, and cost to make prioritisation decisions and sequence backlog items appropriately  

Location and Working Model:
  
This role is based in India with UK working business hours. The role is hybrid, with a mix of on-site and remote work. Specific on-site days will be agreed with your manager.

  

**Skills**

Anaplan, ApptioOne, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Automation, Budget Planning, Data Analysis, Finance Business Partnering, Financial Governance, Financial Operations, Forecasting, IT Financial Management, Microsoft Power Business Intelligence (PBI)  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com , so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Senior Business Finance Analyst
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

**So, what’s the role all about?**

The Senior Business Finance Analyst is responsible for business performance analysis, reporting, and forecasting. Work with team on recognition and backlog reviews, and provides financial modeling, budgeting, and ad hoc analysis that feed long-term strategic planning and resource allocation.

**How will you make an impact?**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline preferred.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant FP&A / business finance experience, ideally with exposure to revenue forecasting, tracking, or recognition.
* Strong Excel/Analytical skills (financial modeling, pivot tables, advanced formulas).
* Ability to work under pressure on multiple projects and deadlines.
* Ability to effectively prioritize workload and manage changes in the direction of the company.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to work cooperatively and collaboratively with all levels of employees and management to maximize performance.
* Ability to act and operate independently with minimal daily direction.
* Confidence to liaise and present to Senior Management.
* Desire to work in a matrixed environment.
* Accuracy and attention to detail.

**Have you got what it takes?**

* Intermediate skill level in MS Office applications.
* Experience with Power BI and Oracle.
* Familiarity with revenue recognition concepts (e.g. deferred revenue, backlog vs. recognized) in a subscription or services-based business.
* Prior technology industry experience.
* **Revenue forecasting & tracking —** own the revenue forecast / recognition and weekly close process. Track sales pipeline, bookings, revenue and renewals.
* **Reporting & analysis —** create meaningful ad-hoc and standard reports and refine existing ones. Each month, analyze actuals against forecast/budget and communicate weekly metrics, monthly results, and variance analysis, as well as quarterly and annual projections.
* **Business partnering —** act as a point of contact for the Revenue team and other stakeholders on financial modeling, budgeting, and business planning questions.
* **Special projects —** stay agile as new projects, initiatives, and opportunities arise — special projects are an opportunity to grow beyond the traditional analyst scope.
* **Modeling —** build models, from simple to sophisticated, from scratch, and improve existing ones. Creativity and new ideas are welcome.
* **Data analysis —** help the business understand, analyze, and draw conclusions from data to support decision-making.

**What’s in it for you?**

Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!

**Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!**

At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

**Requisition ID:11839**
  
**Reporting into:** Tech Manager
  
**Role Type:** Individual Contributor

***About NiCE***

*NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.*

*Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.*

*NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.*

title: Lead Revenue Accountant & Operations Analyst
description:
### **About Us**

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world's leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

  

**Reports To**

Senior Manager, Revenue Operations

**Role Summary**

ChargePoint is looking for a Lead Revenue Accountant & Operations Analyst to champion our end-to-end revenue lifecycle. In this critical role, you will bridge the gap between accounting execution and strategic revenue operations, ensuring the financial integrity of our SaaS, hardware, and services streams. Join us to drive process automation, strengthen our financial frameworks, and support ChargePoint's mission to build the future of e-mobility.

**What You Will Be Doing**
  
As the Lead Revenue Operations Analyst and Accountant, you will combine hands-on accounting execution with strategic revenue operations leadership. You will own the revenue lifecycle—from contract review and ASC 606 compliance through journal entries, reconciliations, and close execution. Acting as a strategic bridge between Revenue Accounting, Sales, Legal, and FP&A, you will focus on driving process automation, maintaining audit-ready financial records, and ensuring the accuracy and timeliness of revenue reporting. Success in your first 6–12 months includes streamlining close activities and elevating team performance through proactive problem resolution.

**What You Will Bring to ChargePoint**

* **Lead** the review and analysis of complex sales contracts, purchase orders, and multi-element arrangements to ensure precise revenue recognition under ASC 606.
* **Manage** revenue arrangements in NetSuite, configuring and validating start/end dates, revenue schedules, billing data, and subsidiary ledger entries.
* **Drive** end-to-end monthly and quarterly revenue close activities, preparing journal entries, revenue deferrals, accruals, and variance analyses.
* **Oversee** tracking and milestone-based recognition for project-based revenue, ensuring deliverables are timely and well-documented.
* **Maintain** standalone selling price (SSP) allocation models and prepare comprehensive, audit-ready documentation for external auditors and internal SOX compliance.
* **Reconcile** revenue data seamlessly across Salesforce, NetSuite, and internal reporting tools to ensure unwavering consistency.
* **Partner** cross-functionally with Sales, Legal, and Operations, serving as the primary escalation point for revenue coding issues and proactive process fixes.
* **Collaborate** with FP&A to support revenue forecasting, partner rebate programs, sales reserves accruals, and ad-hoc financial analysis.
* **Support** state and government-funded project revenue, carefully navigating special handling requirements and mixed-product accounting treatments.
* **Champion** automation and process improvement initiatives to streamline revenue reporting, reduce manual effort, and strengthen compliance frameworks.
* **Mentor** and guide junior revenue analysts and accountants, reviewing their work to elevate team performance and ensure quality compliance.

**Requirements**

* 12 - 15 years of progressive experience in revenue accounting, revenue operations, or general accounting, ideally in a SaaS, hardware, or mixed-technology environment.
* Expert-level understanding of ASC 606, including revenue recognition for multiple performance obligations, variable consideration, and contract modifications.
* Hands-on expertise with ERP systems (NetSuite strongly preferred) and CRM platforms (Salesforce).
* Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and a methodical approach to close execution and audit documentation.
* Demonstrated track record of executing process automation, operational improvement projects, and successful external audit/SOX compliance cycles.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders.
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (e.g., B.Com/BBA), CA/CPA qualification, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience utilizing Business Intelligence (BI) tools such as Tableau or Power BI for financial reporting and analytics.

**Location** India — Remote

We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. ChargePoint is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.

If there is a match between your experiences/skills and the Company needs, we will contact you directly.

ChargePoint is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that welcomes and supports all qualified individuals. In alignment with this commitment, we ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations throughout the employment process.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, or to access any other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact us at **accommodations@chargepoint.com**.

ChargePoint is an equal opportunity employer.  
Applicants only - Recruiting agencies do not contact.

title: Sr. Analyst II FP&A
description:
Overview:

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+  

employees and \~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999,  

Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event  

professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help  

them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people  

together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry  

through innovative technology that powers human connection.  

Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone  

and Vista for $4\.6B in 2023\.  

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like  

entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and  

celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.  

Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human  

connection.  

  

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**  

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At  

Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our  

DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to  

experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll  

thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering  

exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.  

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn,  

iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AIpowered  

collaboration, we’d love to meet you.  

  

**About the Role:**  

We are seeking a strategic, analytically strong FP\&A professional to join our team as an Senior Analyst  

II – FP\&A, supporting Marketing mini\-CFO, in partnering with Cvent's Global Marketing organization —  

spanning Brand, Demand Generation, Events, Digital, Product Marketing, and Regional Field  

Marketing.  

This role sits at the intersection of Marketing and FP\&A. You will be supporting Marketing mini\-CFO to  

drive marketing efficiency and ROI analysis, but you must also deeply understand the \*bookings and  

pipeline world\* — how marketing activity converts into leads, MQLs, SQL, pipeline, and ultimately  

bookings. You will help Marketing and Finance leaders answer the core questions: “what is working,  

what is not working, and where should the next marketing dollar go.”  

In addition to this, the individual would also be required to drive core planning processes such as annual  

budgeting, monthly reforecasting, and cost tracking, while building and interpreting the full marketingto\-  

bookings funnel — website traffic, digital conversion, event conversion, leads, cost per lead, lead  

conversion by tactic, and marketing ROI by LoB. The ideal candidate combines strong financial acumen  

with genuine fluency in what a B2B marketing function should deliver, and the drive to translate data  

into clear recommendations for the Marketing organization and senior leaders.  

This role involves frequent interaction with senior leaders across Marketing, Sales, and Corporate  

Finance teams based in the U.S. and India.


In This Role, You Will::
* Marketing Finance Partnership \& RI (primary focus)


o Act as support to Marketing mini\-CFO to support to the Global Marketing organization,  

partnering with marketing leadership to translate growth strategies, campaign plans, and  

pipeline targets into annual budgets and rolling forecasts.  

o Build, own, and continuously improve the Marketing ROI financial model by LoB —  

connecting spend, activity and outcomes end to end.  

o Develop and track key Marketing efficiency metrics, including:  

* CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost)
* CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value)
* Cost per Lead/MQL (by LoB, by tactic)
* Lead Conversion Rates (by tactic / channel), CTR
* Marketing ROI


o Analyze the full funnel — website traffic, digital conversion, event conversion, leads, and cost  

per lead — and tie each stage to financial and pipeline outcomes.  

o Drive deep\-dive analytics on event ROI, digital campaigns, tradeshows, and content  

marketing performance.  

o Deliver a clear point of view on what's working and what's not working across marketing  

tactics and channels, with concrete, prioritized recommendations for the marketing  

organization.  

o Build and evaluate business cases for marketing initiatives — campaigns, media  

investments, Martech, and events — using ROI, CAC, payback to guide spend prioritization.  

o Support and advise on resource\-allocation decisions across marketing channels and  

geographies.  

* Bookings \& Pipeline Fluency


o Understand and work fluently with the sales forecasting and bookings process, connecting  

marketing funnel metrics (MQLs, pipeline, bookings influence) to bookings outcomes by LoB.  

o Partner on pipeline\-trend and funnel analysis — conversion rates, sales cycle length, and  

pipeline velocity — to assess how marketing feeds the bookings engine.  

o Align marketing investment views with bookings and pipeline targets so finance tells one  

consistent growth story.  

* Stakeholder \& Cross\-functional Work


o Partner with Sales, Marketing Ops, and Data/Analytics teams to ensure consistent, trusted  

measurement frameworks.  

o Create executive\-level dashboards, presentations, and financial insights to support strategic  

initiatives, and present them confidently to non\-financial and senior audiences.  

o Lead or support ad\-hoc strategic projects, including M\&A / acquisition integration and costoptimization  

initiatives.  

o Extract and analyze data using tools like Salesforce, Adaptive Insights, Excel, and other  

analytics platforms.
Here's What You Need::
* 7–10 years of experience in FP\&A, business finance, or a related field.
* Preferred background (either path works): experience in a B2B organization either (a) in


Marketing Data \& ROI Analytics, or (b) in Finance partnering with Marketing — with real  

exposure to marketing funnel dynamics and bookings/pipeline.  

* Deep understanding of B2B marketing funnel metrics, digital campaign dynamics,


channel/tactic\-level ROI, and a clear view of what a B2B marketing function should bring to the  

business.  

* Solid understanding of the bookings and pipeline world — sales forecasting, funnel/conversion


analysis, and how marketing influences bookings  

* Strong data\-driven mindset and the ability to structure and interpret large, imperfect datasets to


generate insights.  

* Expertise in financial modeling, forecasting, and metric development — including the ability to


think through a marketing ROI model from first principles.  

* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce CRM, Adaptive Insights or similar tools preferred.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to present insights to non\-financial and senior


stakeholders; proven ability to work closely with senior leaders is strongly preferred.  

* Strong drive, curiosity, and willingness to learn.
* MBA or CFA preferred

title: Sr Accountant
description:
**About the Role**
  

  

We are looking for a Senior Accountant on the Global Intercompany Team to be part of a team that is critical to the company's month\-end close process and SOX compliance. In this exciting role, you will support the intercompany accounting operations for assigned regions and work cross\-functionally with Finance Engineering and other teams to enhance Uber's internal systems and processes.
  

  

We are looking for this individual to act as a cross\-functional business partner in the on\-shoring and structuring of new legal entities and to support strategic initiatives such as M\&A integrations, including the establishment and ongoing support of intercompany operations resulting from those integrations, as well as IP restructurings and tax initiatives.
  

  

This role requires an individual with strong knowledge of intercompany accounting and multi\-entity structures, as well as a curious and analytical mindset. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, enjoys digging into complex topics, asks the right questions, and is resourceful in finding answers rather than waiting for direction. The ideal candidate is comfortable navigating ambiguity, investigating issues independently, and proactively identifying solutions and opportunities for improvement.
  

  

The ideal candidate will also embrace AI as part of their day\-to\-day work, continuously exploring how AI and emerging technologies can automate repetitive activities, improve analysis, and create more efficient and scalable accounting processes.
  

  

If a fast\-moving, constantly evolving environment excites you, this could be an excellent opportunity for you!
  

  

**What the Candidate Will Do**
* Own and support key intercompany accounting operations for assigned regions, serving as a primary point of contact for intercompany matters and ensuring accurate and timely execution of related accounting activities.
* Actively participate in the monthly close process, including preparation of reports, flux analysis, and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Prepare and review intercompany journal entries in accordance with transfer pricing regulations to ensure a timely monthly, quarterly, and year\-end close.
* Perform FX analysis and clearing for various intercompany transactions, settlements, payments, and collections on behalf.
* Be responsible for global monthly intercompany balances across 250\+ entities, including the netting process, tripartite settlements for intercompany loans, and follow\-up on related queries.
* Investigate and resolve elimination issues and review automated intercompany entries coming from various systems to ensure a smooth consolidation process.
* Set up complex transfer pricing calculations in iCAN (Intercompany Accounting and Netting, our in\-house tool).
* Support M\&A integrations from an intercompany accounting perspective and help establish and support the resulting intercompany operations, including new entities, intercompany relationships, accounting flows, and related activities.
* Participate in strategic accounting projects and initiatives, including IP restructurings, tax initiatives, new revenue standards, and support for new product launches.
* Coordinate the review of intercompany agreements with Regional Tax, Legal, and Compliance teams and maintain intercompany relationships in the global intercompany system.
* Act as a business partner with the Tax Team on on\-shoring entities and changes in tax structures, supporting the implementation of changes relevant to intercompany accounting operations.
* Actively explore and adopt AI\-enabled solutions as part of day\-to\-day activities, identifying opportunities to automate manual processes, enhance analysis, and improve the efficiency and scalability of intercompany accounting operations.
* Proactively investigate complex or unfamiliar intercompany matters, leveraging available data, systems, documentation, and cross\-functional resources to understand root causes and recommend solutions.
* Support process improvement initiatives and system implementations, providing intercompany accounting expertise and assisting with the testing and implementation of process and system enhancements.
* Perform and maintain assigned internal controls and support critical ad\-hoc analysis and projects as needed.
* Collaborate with key cross\-functional partners, including Finance, Engineering, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Internal Audit, and other teams on a variety of initiatives.
* Manage outsourced GBS/accounting support teams where needed.

**What the Candidate Will Need**
* 6\+ years of relevant accounting experience, with knowledge of intercompany accounting, transfer pricing, consolidation, and accounting in a multi\-entity environment.
* Strong understanding of fundamental accounting concepts and US GAAP, including foreign currency (FX), intercompany eliminations, and financial reporting requirements in an international environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex accounting matters, identify root causes, and independently develop potential solutions.
* A curious and proactive mindset, with the ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, prioritize competing responsibilities, and manage multiple tasks in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong communication and business partnering skills, with the ability to clearly communicate accounting matters, risks, issues, and status updates to both accounting and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and proficiency with data analysis tools such as Microsoft Excel; experience with SQL or other data analysis tools is a plus.
* Interest in leveraging AI and emerging technologies to improve day\-to\-day accounting activities, analysis, and operational efficiency.

**Bonus Points**
* Experience with Oracle ERP environments and intercompany accounting systems; experience with Oracle Fusion is a plus.
* Experience with FCCS (Financial Consolidation and Close) or similar financial consolidation platforms.
* Experience supporting ERP implementations, system migrations, testing, or finance transformation initiatives.
* Experience working with global intercompany operations, transfer pricing models, or complex legal entity structures.
Experience supporting M\&A integrations, entity restructurings, or tax\-driven initiatives from an accounting perspective  
* 

  

  

**Ready to Ride?**  

  

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.  

  

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

title: Senior Revenue Accountant - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**
### **About JumpCloud®**


JumpCloud® is the AI\-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

### **JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

  

**About the Role:**



We’re looking for a high\-energy, hands\-on Senior Revenue Accountant who has significant experience with reviewing B2B SaaS sales contracts, managing appropriate revenue recognition in accordance with ASC 606, and participating in day\-to\-day billing and revenue accounting activities. The ideal candidate thinks strategically on a process level and also executes in the details. They are comfortable using core systems and tools and think automation first when designing process. Join our small but driven and expanding team to help build the processes and procedures that will support JumpCloud as we continue to expand globally.



### **What you’ll be doing:**

* Review B2B SaaS sales contracts to ensure 100% compliance with ASC 606 (or relevant revenue recognition standards) for all revenue transactions.
* Review and execute Sales Orders, billing transactions and revenue schedules
* Apply revenue recognition policies to complex contracts and issues.
* Proactively identify and implement additional controls or reconciliations needed within the Q2C process.
* Develop and execute reconciliations for areas identified as needing additional controls or tie\-outs.
* Maintain a near\-zero error rate in revenue\-related transactions, approvals, and reconciliations.
* Complete all revenue\-related close tasks within established deadlines, consistently.
* Produce accurate and timely revenue reports for management review.
* Identify and assist in implementing efficiencies to minimize month\-end close time.
* Prepare monthly revenue and reclassification journal entries.
* Conduct monthly revenue flux analysis and miscellaneous revenue adjustments as needed.
* Maintain all transaction support records and documentation in an organized and audit\-ready state.
* Coordinate efforts to gather documentation and reporting for auditors.
* Participate and contribute to audit walkthroughs and ad\-hoc discussions.
* Assist in ensuring SOX compliance regarding revenue\-related controls.
* Demonstrate or develop proficiency in SFDC, with the ability to extract necessary data in the form of basic to moderately complex reports.
* Demonstrate or develop proficiency in NetSuite, including the ability to extract necessary data for reports and saved searches with limited support.
* Demonstrate or develop an understanding of the Advanced Revenue Module (ARM) in NetSuite to trace revenue transactions from transaction documents to the general ledger.
* Assist in identifying and troubleshooting system\-related revenue accounting issues.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with Sales, Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, and other departments.
* Recognize and effectively communicate the cross\-functional impacts of accounting projects, changes, or discoveries.
* Effectively communicate revenue accounting requirements to non\-financial stakeholders.
* Work with sales teams to ensure contracts are structured to allow for scalable processing and proper revenue recognition.
* Identify and assist in implementing process improvements, particularly automation and AI enabled processes, to enhance efficiency, scalability, and accuracy in revenue accounting.
* Develop and maintain up\-to\-date documentation on revenue accounting policies and procedures.
* Provide insightful analysis of revenue trends and variances.
* Develop and maintain key reconciliations to ensure complete and accurate revenue accounting and ARR reporting on a monthly basis.
* Maintain a deep understanding of current and evolving revenue recognition standards.
* Participate in relevant professional development activities.
* Take an active role in researching and documenting changes to company revenue recognition accounting policies.
* Maintain a positive, professional, and constructive tone in all communications.
### **Preferred Qualifications:**


* BS/BA degree in Accounting or Finance.
* CPA (or similar) preferred.
* Revenue Recognition 3\-5 years exposure in a SaaS company (preferably B2B) or 2\-4 years Big 4 public accounting experience with SaaS engagements.
* Solid understanding of US GAAP particularly ASC 606\.
* Intermediate to Advanced Excel skills (lookups, pivot tables, etc.).
* Experience with NetSuite and Salesforce CPQ a plus.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to problem solve, both from an accounting and system perspective.
* Self\-motivated with the ability to multi\-task and work in a dynamic fast\-paced environment.
* Enthusiastic attitude and willingness to jump in and help out as needed.
* Flexibility to adapt quickly and thrive in a fast\-growing company.
###### **\#LI\-MH1**

 **Where you’ll be working/Location:**
JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

**This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.**
**Language:**JumpCloud® has teams in 15\+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

**Why JumpCloud?**
If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.

One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." \- Rajat Bhargava, CEO

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.

JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

**Scam Notice:**
Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

\#LI\-Remote \#BI\-Remote
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.
